requirements: R1: The runtime launcher's POST request to http://runtime-launcher:8091/healthcheck must return a successful response without I/O error.

slices.title: Resolve runtime-launcher healthcheck I/O error
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime-launcher fix for this epic, I want to resolve the cause of the unexpected end of file on the healthcheck POST request, so that the application startup is properly recorded as healthy.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a deployed backend instance
When the runtime-launcher makes a POST request to http://runtime-launcher:8091/healthcheck
Then the connection succeeds and returns a valid HTTP response indicating health, avoiding the unexpected end of file error.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Runtime launcher health check blocking pipeline
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce runtime health check failure rate from 100% to 0%
